blocks.text: After Banda’s death, the true Khalsa is contrasted with those who accepted service, jagirs, or easier arrangements under Muslim rule; the Tat Khalsa alone keeps to the hard path.
Nakedness, hunger, wandering, and suffering are embraced as the real marks of loyalty, while refuge is still granted to those who come under Khalsa protection.
Tat Khalsa is the page’s core phrase because it defines survival through renunciation rather than accommodation.
